Bill.BriefDescription: Repealing the unfunded state remittance for persons eligible for the federal earned income tax credit.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to repealing the unfunded state remittance forpersons eligible for the federal earned income tax credit; andrepealing RCW 82.08.0206 and 82.08.02061.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The following acts or parts of acts are eachrepealed: RCW 82.08.0206 (ExemptionsWorking familiesEligible lowincome persons) and 2008 c 325 s 2; and RCW 82.08.02061 (ExemptionsWorking familiesReport tolegislature) and 2008 c 325 s 3.
